title: Part Twelve: Epstein: What Is Documented

sections.brief: The court and DOJ record only: Wexner power of attorney, Farmer complaint, 2008 NPA and Marra ruling, 2019 arrest and death, Maxwell conviction, the July 2025 DOJ/FBI memo, the Blanche–Maxwell interview, the Transparency Act releases to 2026. Figures: time

The intelligence claim decomposed: Robert Maxwell's Jerusalem funeral (documented), the Acosta 'belonged to intelligence' report (single anonymous source, denied under oath), blackmail theories (not established; DOJ finding), documented Israeli business ties; the line between association and an intelligence operation. Figures: compare
Barak–Epstein meetings and statements, the Sum (E.B.) 2015 partnership and Carbyne money path to Axon's 2026 purchase, the Ivory Coast emails with source caveats, Thiel's Valar funds. Figures: flow
